<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Flowering Path](/Feats.aspx?ID=4319) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Ardande" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=498" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 49

**Frequency**
once per day

</column>

---

Vitality and elemental wood flows out from your body and into the earth, infusing it with a stream of new life. When you walk, you leave blooming flowers and sprouting vines in your wake. For the next minute, each time you Step or Stride, you create [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) in each square you leave during your movement.
name: Flowering Path
